shortBulletSummary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced record $4.5 billion net outflows in June, pushing BTC below $60K.
Europe's comprehensive Markets in Crypto Assets (MiCA) regulation is now fully in force as of July 1.
Ethereum faces mixed signals with some institutional interest offset by spot ETF outflows and whale selling.
Challenging macro outlook with persistent inflation and hawkish Fed expectations pressures crypto and risk assets.
